title: Per-session deviation stack and resume focus
summary: Key the side-task stack and resume focus by session id, sessionless keeps project-wide
description:
Current state: task ownership is per session (activeOwnerSession, packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts:263, sessionId param at :256/:362) but the approved-deviation stack (schema.ts:168) and resume focus (current phase, in-progress tasks) are project-wide, so with several agents one agent's task_switch records the return target for everyone.

Work: key the deviation stack and resume focus by session id in plan-core (task-selection.ts, plan-store.ts, project-context.ts as needed); task_switch/task_deviation/task_recommend/load recap use the caller's session. Callers without a session id keep today's project-wide behaviour. Migrate existing stored deviations without data loss. Cover with tests for two sessions switching and returning independently. Riskiest phase: touches switch and recommendation logic; run focused tests only.

Preserve: LIFO return semantics per session, RESUME REQUIRED behaviour, recommendation claims and on-hold logic.
